deck_name: Court de Gébelin's Tarot — The Birth of the 'Book of Thoth' (1781)

atout-00.name: 0 — The Fool (Le Mat)
atout-00.Scene: A figure in a jester's costume walks with a bundle on a stick, a small animal at his heels. The plate is an engraving based on a Marseille-type deck, rendered in de Gébelin's archaeological style.

atout-01.name: 1 — The Magician (Le Bateleur)
atout-01.Scene: A standing figure at a table spread with various small objects and tools. He wears a wide-brimmed hat and gestures with a wand. The engraving simplifies the Marseille Bateleur.

atout-02.name: 2 — The High Priestess (La Papesse)
atout-02.Scene: A seated woman in a veil and headdress, holding a book. She wears a papal tiara, shown enthroned frontally. The plate follows the Marseille Papesse closely.

atout-03.name: 3 — The Empress (L'Impératrice)
atout-03.Scene: A winged empress is shown seated on a throne, holding a sceptre, with an eagle-bearing shield at her side. Her crown and wings appear in the engraved version.

atout-04.name: 4 — The Emperor (L'Empereur)
atout-04.Scene: A crowned emperor sits on a throne in profile, holding a sceptre and orb. The plate renders the standard Marseille Emperor in engraved line.

atout-05.name: 5 — The Hierophant (Le Pape)
atout-05.Scene: A hierophant or pope is enthroned between two pillars, raising his hand in blessing toward two kneeling figures. He wears a triple crown and holds a triple cross.

atout-06.name: 6 — The Lovers (L'Amoureux)
atout-06.Scene: A young man stands between two women while a winged Cupid aims an arrow from above. The engraving follows the Marseille 'Amoureux' composition.

atout-07.name: 7 — The Chariot (Le Chariot)
atout-07.Scene: A crowned warrior in a canopied chariot is drawn by two horses. He holds a sceptre. The Marseille chariot composition is reproduced faithfully in the engraving.

atout-08.name: 8 — Justice (La Justice)
atout-08.Scene: A crowned woman sits on a throne holding a sword upright and scales in the other hand, in the standard Marseille Justice pose.

atout-09.name: 9 — The Hermit (L'Hermite)
atout-09.Scene: An elder in a long robe walks hunched over a staff, holding a lantern before him. The Hermit is shown in profile moving across a blank ground.

atout-10.name: 10 — Wheel of Fortune (La Roue de Fortune)
atout-10.Scene: A spoked wheel at the card's centre turns while figures cling to its rim at various positions. A sphinx or animal figure sits atop the wheel.

atout-11.name: 11 — Strength (La Force)
atout-11.Scene: A woman gently holds open the jaws of a lion. The standard Marseille Strength composition is reproduced in the engraving.

atout-12.name: 12 — The Hanged Man (Le Pendu)
atout-12.Scene: A man hangs inverted by one ankle from a gallows, his free leg crossed behind, his arms relaxed at his sides.

atout-13.name: 13 — Death (La Mort)
atout-13.Scene: A skeleton with a great scythe harvests a field strewn with severed body parts. The plate is an engraved version of the unnamed Death card.

atout-14.name: 14 — Temperance (Tempérance)
atout-14.Scene: A winged figure pours liquid between two vessels, standing in the standard Marseille Temperance pose.

atout-15.name: 15 — The Devil (Le Diable)
atout-15.Scene: A horned figure on a pedestal with two smaller creatures chained at its feet. The plate renders the Marseille Devil in simplified engraved form.

atout-16.name: 16 — The Tower (La Maison-Dieu)
atout-16.Scene: A tower on high ground is struck by fire or lightning; its top is blasted off and two figures fall from its height.

atout-17.name: 17 — The Star (L'Étoile)
atout-17.Scene: A kneeling figure pours water from two pitchers near a pool. Above, a large star is flanked by seven smaller stars.

atout-18.name: 18 — The Moon (La Lune)
atout-18.Scene: A crescent moon hangs above a landscape with two towers, two dogs, and a crayfish emerging from water.

atout-19.name: 19 — The Sun (Le Soleil)
atout-19.Scene: A radiant sun shines over two children in a garden. The standard Marseille Sun plate is reproduced in engraving.

atout-20.name: 20 — Judgement (Le Jugement)
atout-20.Scene: An angel blows a trumpet from clouds above while three figures rise from tombs.

atout-21.name: 21 — The World (Le Monde)
atout-21.Scene: A dancer at the centre of a laurel wreath, with the four tetramorphs at the corners. The Marseille World composition is reproduced as an engraved plate.

emg-book-of-thoth.name: The 'Book of Thoth' — The Birth of Occult Tarot
emg-book-of-thoth.Scene: The 22 atout plates from Antoine Court de Gébelin's 'Le Monde Primitif' (1781), Volume VIII. Each plate is a rough line engraving based on a Tarot de Marseille deck, accompanied in the text by de Gébelin's elaborate theory that the tarot is the surviving fragments of the Egyptian Book of Thoth.
